description: Which tests exercise this symbol? Walks the call/type graph backwards from the target to test files (strongest evidence, names the test-case symbol), then adds test files that only reach it through imports (weaker signal). Complements change_impact: this answers "what should I run?" for one symbol directly.

cursor.description: continuation token from a truncated response; repeat the same arguments with it

max_tokens.description: soft cap on response size in estimated tokens; truncated output says how to get the rest

min_confidence.description: ignore call edges below this confidence

path.description: with line: innermost symbol at that position

name: tests_for_symbol
title: Tests for symbol
